text:
olga.p: Postmortem published: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/embeddings-drift-1842. Short summary: embedding quality drifted after an automatic quantization update in the ingest pipeline, causing degraded similarity search scores for a subset of customers for ~45m.

tom.v: Thanks for the link. Any immediate mitigations listed?

olga.p: Yes 1) rolled back the quantized encoder to previous build (done) 2) re-ran nightly reindex for affected tenants 3) paused automatic quantization job until validation gates added. See "Action items" in doc.

srini.g: I'll own the validation gates. Plan: add per-model A/B similarity checks, and a threshold-based hold for auto-quantize. ETA 2026-04-06.

comms-jo: I'll draft a customer-facing note summarising impact and remediation. Prefer neutral wording and include affected timeframe + compensatory credit options. Targeting draft by 2026-03-29.

ops-bot: Follow-up review scheduled 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC Channel: #postmortems Link: https://meet.redwood.com/embeddings-1842

incident-bot: RCA published by @olga.p Severity: P3 Duration: 00:45:12 Tags: embeddings, quantization, reindex

tom.v: For the reindex, do we have an ETA on completion for impacted customers?

olga.p: Reindex is in progress; estimated completion 2026-03-28 22:00 UTC for tenants flagged in the doc. We'll post progress to the doc checklist.

srini.g: Also adding unit checks to the quantize pipeline: token-level checksum and sample-embedding drift test in CI. Will PR today.

comms-jo: I'll sync with legal on wording and post draft when ready.

olga.p: Core lessons: add validation for online quantization, add reindex rollback playbook, and expose drift metrics to the console. Doc has 7/30-day checkpoints. Please update the action items as you close them. :thumbsup:
